purpose: Operator-norm verification of Biquard glued metric on chi=8 positive-mirror rows

naive_construction.description: g_naive = chi*t*g_EH + (1-chi)*g_orb WITHOUT Biquard correction h
naive_construction.scaling: O(1) -- NOT suitable for Yau-26 pinching
naive_construction.reason: Ric_EH = 0 but target is Lambda*g, giving ||Lambda*g||_op = |Lambda| on core

corrected_construction.description: h_{t,phi} = e_h + t*h where L_EH(h) = Lambda*e_h + obstructions, h ~ rho^2 at infinity
corrected_construction.condition: First obstruction killed: R_pm(p)*zeta = 0 (automatic at bi-Kahler locus with zeta in ker)
corrected_construction.key_point: h is NOT explicit; it is the solution of an elliptic PDE on EH

multi_bubble_accounting_discharged.method: Operator-norm (sup over tangent directions of Ricci endomorphism)
multi_bubble_accounting_discharged.result: Confirmed: ||Ric - Lambda*g||_op,g_t <= C*t^{1/2} for finite collection of EH insertions with killed first obstruction
multi_bubble_accounting_discharged.caveat: Constant C depends on the number of bubbles and their separation; for 4 disjoint A_1 points on (S^2 x S^2)/Z_2, C is uniform in t

next_steps: Construct explicit numerical h by solving L_EH(h) = Lambda*e_h on truncated EH domain
Assemble full glued metric on the desingularized manifold
Run Einstein-DeTurck flow from the corrected metric
Compare convergence on r=0 (del Pezzo control) vs r=2 (balanced mixed row)
